projects.name: Split — Receipt Splitter
projects.description: I built Split to end the group-dinner math argument: photograph the receipt, tap who shared what, and it works out what each person owes. Gemini vision reads the items off the photo, and you can assign them in plain English. Tax and tip are split by what each person ordered, and the result exports as a shareable image.

projects.name: MedCS Lab Website
projects.description: I designed and built the official website for the MedCS Lab at Northeastern, a research group working at the intersection of medicine and computer science. The site highlights the lab’s mission and team, with smooth scrolling, animated sections, and a clean, modern layout that reflects the lab’s professionalism.

projects.name: Train Tracker
projects.description: A modern web app that lets users track real-time Amtrak train progress using scraped data from RailRat. Built with React, Express, and custom CSS, it features a searchable train ID autocomplete, mobile optimization, and a dark mode toggle for better accessibility. Deployed using Vercel (frontend) and Render (backend).

projects.name: Recipe Finder
projects.description: A modern Recipe Finder web app built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. It allows users to search for recipes using the Spoonacular API, save favorites, and explore detailed cooking instructions. The app features a clean, responsive UI and is deployed on Vercel for fast performance.

projects.name: Overlap - Find time to meet with friends
projects.description: Overlap finds a time when the whole group is free. Each friend joins a shared group link and adds their calendar feed (Google share links work too), and a heatmap shades every slot by how many people are available. Private calendar URLs are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and only ever read on the server.

projects.name: Chess Record — Weekly W/L Tracker
projects.description: Chess Record pulls your games from the chess.com API and shows your wins, losses, and draws over the past seven days. Select any day to see that day’s record, filter by bullet, blitz, or rapid to track rating changes, and export a shareable summary image. It’s a single HTML file with no dependencies.
